dict.string: Lane writes down what you say when you dictate, and records a meeting only while you press Record. The audio stays on this Mac.
Lane records the other side of a call only while you press Record. The audio stays on this Mac.
Lane turns speech into text on this Mac, with a model it downloaded. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Lane reads your upcoming events so it can prepare you for meetings from your own memories. Nothing is sent anywhere.

Lane reads names and nicknames from your Contacts so it can recognise the people in your memories. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Lane asks the app in front what you are looking at, so it can remember it for you. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Lane needs this only to read the window titles it is remembering for you.
